data.long_meaning: The name Siusan is derived from the Latin 'Sius' meaning 'god' and the suffix '-an' which is a diminutive form. This name is a feminine form of the Latin name Sius and it signifies 'God's grace' or 'gift of God'. The name Siusan carries the meaning “God's grace, gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Siusan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
